system.description: This blade is both old and Tilean, which gives it an exotic appearance. It is inlaid with the spear of Myrmidia and a single word in archaic Tilean: \"Acitus.\" Damage Rating: 6 Critical Rating: 3 (2 vs. goblins) Group: Hand Weapon Qualities: None Encumbrance: 3 Acitus has a special hatred for goblins. Failure to kill goblins when presented with the opportunity makes the wielder irritable and unpleasant, causing him to suffer 1 stress. If denied the opportunity to kill goblins by his comrades, the party tension meter may advance.
